cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 95 since November 2022. Business executive and president of Frances Holk Insurance Inc. Co-founded the Jennifer Claire Moore Foundation. Won the June 2026 GOP runoff and was the only candidate listed in the November 2026 general election.
cands.gaps: The pages I could read don't say where she grew up, when she came to Alabama, or how long she has run her insurance business. Ballotpedia's list of her sponsored bills was empty, so I found no bill or action to match against any platform issue. I found no statements from her on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, guns, abortion, schools or police. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. Ballotpedia found no endorsements for her in 2026. I found no controversies or foreign ties in the pages available.
